articles.title: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev fires back at AMC's Aron in escalating fight over stock tokens
articles.snippet: Tenev told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Wednesday that public companies shouldn't have veto power over third-party securities that reference their shares.

articles.title: Consensys to split MetaMask into its own firm while staying silent on IPO
articles.snippet: The existing company, Consensys Software Inc., will rebrand as MetaMask under Ethereum co-founder Joe Lubin as chairman and CEO.

articles.title: U.S. Bank takes next step towards launching its stablecoin with cross-border payment test
articles.snippet: The fifth-largest U.S. commercial bank said it is exploring USBDC stablecoin for treasury payments, liquidity management and collateral after completing a live transaction.

articles.title: India’s financial intelligence unit flags 15 crypto platforms for AML lapses
articles.snippet: The Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) issued non-compliance notices to what it calls virtual digital asset service providers.

articles.title: Consensys to split into MetaMask and institutional blockchain company
articles.snippet: The restructuring will separate MetaMask’s consumer business from Consensys’ Ethereum protocols and institutional blockchain infrastructure operations.
